newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia car industry report deadline extended.
newsitem.headline: Australia car industry report deadline extended.

text.p: The Australian Industry Commission said on Friday the deadline for its final report on the automotive industry had been extended by two weeks.
The commission would now report its findings on May 26 after Australian Treasurer Peter Costello agreed to the extension, it said in a statement.
Commission chairman Bill Scales had requested the extension to allow the thorough study of three outstanding submissions.
"The commission is still waiting on the results of three separate economic modelling studies of the effects of proposed automotive industry tariff reductions," Scales said.
"Given the high profile some participants have placed on economic modelling, and given the late delivery of the studies, extra time is needed to thoroughly evaluate the various model results."

The commission had been studying responses to its draft report into the automotive industry, which supported continued reductions in tariffs until they matched the general manufacturing protection rate of five percent.
The commission said in the draft report that target should be reached by 2004.
